question: What remedial period applies when the prescribed practice is interrupted?
premises: The prescribed practice may be interrupted.
A loss or omission is acknowledged.
inference: If there is loss of the practice, then even in that case three days are required at the end.
uncertainties: Exact remedial action during dinatrayam is implied
plain_english: When there is an interruption of the practice, even then three days are required at the end.
